report.observed: DOB fields cropped at fixed header while a large blank area remains above the sticky Continue footer and visible numeric keyboard. User reports equivalent behavior on other pages.
report.rootCause: Onboarding content flexGrow fills the full scroll viewport. Default controller inset mode then extends that already stretched content by keyboard height plus footerHeight, even though the footer already occupies height as a normal-flow sibling. This permits unnecessary blank scrolling.

changes: OnboardingScreen uses controller mode=layout so keyboard space participates in flex sizing instead of extending a viewport-sized blank region.
